sourceText: User request on 2026-07-03: now that the agent is free, implement the remaining historical 1400+ seeds one-time backfill into candidates and trial/matched-control/timer automatic experiments.
normalizedOutcome: Proofbound provides CLI automation to backfill all currently proposable historical seeds into inert candidate playbooks and to run bounded trial/matched-control/timer experiment steps without activating candidates unless existing evidence-activation guards pass.
acceptanceClaim: A validated B-5f5b implementation adds commands and tests proving full historical backfill creates only candidate playbooks, trial exposure records non-authoritative evidence, and timer automation delegates to guarded apply paths without bypassing activation evidence.
